headline: UN chief visits Haiti, where a new 'gang-suppression force' will be deployed
context: U.N. Secretary-General António Guterres's visit to Port-au-Prince comes as gang violence persists. According to U.N. data, 2,300 people have been killed in Haiti this year, with another 100 kidnapped.
